method: harness: deterministic simulation, one command per round, 10 ticks apart, 1800 rounds = 18 000 ticks, shared boot, one named outcome per row
criteria: A1-2v2 (work/product/STRAT-002-decision-g2.md 1.2): scored table = named rows only; rows[].credits reported but not scored; starvedMax/starvedMean promoted out of stages[]; creditsEarned and creditsPer1000Batches added

supply.name: regular
supply.note: one command per round, 10 ticks apart, ungated wreck pulse (the g1 cadence)

rows.levels: sorter:L16 furnace:L14 polymerRecycler:L13 wireMill:L13 copperSeparator:L14 platePress:L12 circuitAssembler:L12 signalLab:L11

buffer.required: leads one mechanism-adjacent column by >= 5 % relative or >= 10 absolute

draw.required: powerLimitedRounds = 0 with both others >= 200, minPowerRatio gap >= 0.25
